text.zh-Hans: Mac 版 0.3.9 及更早：请到 s2arm.com 下载 dmg 覆盖安装，先不要用应用内更新——旧更新器可能更新到一半，留下新旧混装。0.3.10 起应用内更新已换新，可以正常用。
text.en: Mac 0.3.9 or earlier: download the dmg from s2arm.com and install it over the old app. Don't use in-app update on these versions; the old updater can stop halfway and leave a mixed install. From 0.3.10 on, in-app update works normally.
